From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Confucius (551–479 BC), Lunyu (Chinese), translated by James Legge (1815–1897), 1861, in the edition of 1893. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
